items.class: additive re-ask merge duplicates reworded records
items.rule: merge_reask_answer must match re-ask records to originals by overlapping located spans in the law text (and by citation), not by quote Jaccard; only truly new spans are added; test on 2011-A2411 and 2011-S2704; score on gold before enabling
notes: Oct 30 2026: 7 of 100 re-asks skipped because replace mode needs the whole law re-emitted (77-177 KB omnibus laws with 26-101 records: 2011-A55, 2009-S8314, 2011-S6732, 2013-S6358, 2011-S6255, 2013-S2605, 2013-S6357); a span-based additive merge would let a narrow re-ask answer only the listed sentences

Nov 1 2026: span merge built behind NYS_REASK_MODE=span (merge_reask_span; 27 tests). Sandbox on 2009/2011/2013: strict 81.5 -> 78.2, real 95.0 -> 92.7, recall 77.75 -> 77.81, +173 records, unmatched 15 -> 49. NOT the default. Next: drop first-answer records whose sentence the re-ask packet flagged but the re-ask omitted (the re-ask judged them), then re-measure; also inspect the 34 new unmatched before any further rule.

Nov 12 2026 (Tal approved evaluating it): full scratch ingest of all 9 sessions, span vs replace on the same answers: span stores 1,951 gold-law records vs 1,919, strict 77.2% vs 80.9%, real 94.2% vs 95.6%, recall 83.8% both. Not adopted: the span merge adds noise without recall. A merge would need to add only records the re-ask's located spans show the original lacked AND that pass every gate; re-asks stay in replace mode.
